purpose: Close the fixed historical research program without lowering or redefining any gate.
completion_rule: All required evidence must exist and parse where applicable; retrospective directional search closes at the saturation decision. Prospective monitoring continues as monitoring and is not counted as unfinished historical research.
production_rule: Only a target-specific submodel that independently passes every locked gate may emit a formal signal. A passing opening-gap model may not be relabeled as cash-close or multi-day direction.
